messages:
maria: quick q before i open the PR — do we allow HSM-wrapped service keys to ever be exported into pod env vars at startup? worried about startup logs leaking stuff. cc @jon @kevin
jon: short answer: we should avoid putting raw keys into env. wrapped key fetched from vault + HSM unwrap is fine if unwrap never gets logged. what flow are you doing?
maria: sidecar fetches wrapped blob from vault, calls HSM to unwrap during init, then writes /run/secrets/serv-key and we export it for the child process. saw a startup error that printed `Unwrapped key: <hex>` in logs. is that an immediate rotate?
kevin: if the hex is in logs, treat as leaked. rotate. also check if those logs were forwarded to the log platform. @ellie any idea on pipeline? :thinking:
ellie: app logs -> rsyslog -> kinesis -> log-platform. we have regex redaction but it may not match this pattern. can you paste the snippet (sanitized) + the kubectl command you used?
maria: snippet:
```
2026-03-16T12:03:21Z ERROR bootstrap Unwrapped key: 3f2a9b7c9d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c
```
kubectl logs -c bootstrap svc/prod-api-1 -n prod --since=1h
jon: our current redaction only covers `(?i)api_key=\w{32}` and a few named fields. we should add a rule to catch `Unwrapped key:` and generic hex strings >16 chars. also check retention/forwarding window — if forwarded, we need deletion/retention override.
kevin: also confirm who can `kubectl logs` in prod. `view` on pods and `get` on pods/logs may be granted to some service accounts. if a CI or ops SA has access, rotate and audit those tokens. recommend emergency rotation ticket and notify stakeholders.
maria: who approves emergency rotation? do we need sec sign-off or infra can do immediate rotate?
ellie: @kevin and @jon can approve emergency rotations. file a rotation ticket and tag it `incident:sec`. if the logs reached the log-platform we need to list indices and request deletion.
vault-bot: vault-bot: detected write to /run/secrets/serv-key on prod-api-1 by svc-account bootstrap-sa at 2026-03-16T12:02:59Z
jon: good — looks like bootstrap ran with debug enabled. debug prints probably leaked the value. root cause: debug on in prod. maria, did you run with debug toggled?
maria: yep, debug was on for a test and i forgot to revert. my bad. opening ticket now, will rotate.
kevin: :thumbsup: include the log indices, timeframe, and a list of SAs that accessed pods/logs. also add remediation: no debug in prod; enhance redaction regex; change sidecar to never log key material.
ellie: i'll patch the redact rules and stage it. we'll also add pre-start scrub hook to ensure env vars/temps are removed before any log output.
maria: opened ticket PROD-ROT-4827 and linked logs. starting rotation now; will post when done.
jon: after rotation run: `kubectl logs -n prod svc/prod-api-1 --since=24h | grep -i \"Unwrapped key\"` to confirm no other occurrences. audit KMS/HSM unwrap permissions — only `hsm-admin` group should have unwrap privilege.
kevin: also consider changing sidecar so it never places key into env; mount as file with strict perms and pass fd to process. structured logs WITHOUT values please.
maria: will do both. thanks everyone, will follow up when rotation + log scrub complete. :lock:
